mapper.sql: EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM learning_enrollment e JOIN learning_course c ON c.id=e.course_id WHERE e.student_id=u.id AND e.active=1 AND c.mentor_id=#{mentorId} AND c.status='PUBLISHED' AND c.deleted=0)
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_user WHERE id=#{id} AND role_id=#{roleId} AND status='0'

SELECT u.id,u.nick_name AS name,u.user_name AS username FROM sys_user u WHERE u.role_id=10 AND u.status='0' AND AND (u.user_name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') OR u.nick_name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%')) ORDER BY u.nick_name,u.id
SELECT u.id,u.nick_name AS name,u.user_name AS username FROM sys_user u WHERE u.id=#{studentId} AND u.role_id=10 AND u.status='0' AND
SELECT id,role_id,status FROM sys_user WHERE id IN #{id} ORDER BY id FOR UPDATE

SELECT u.id FROM sys_user u WHERE u.role_id=10 AND u.status='0' AND u.id IN #{id} AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM learning_enrollment e JOIN learning_course c ON c.id=e.course_id WHERE e.student_id=u.id AND e.active=1 AND c.mentor_id=#{mentorId} AND c.status='PUBLISHED' AND c.deleted=0 AND c.id IN #{courseId}) ORDER BY u.id
SELECT * FROM encouragement_message WHERE mentor_id=#{mentorId} AND client_key=#{clientKey}
SELECT student_id FROM encouragement_recipient WHERE message_id=#{id} ORDER BY student_id
SELECT id,body,recipient_count,sent_at FROM encouragement_message WHERE mentor_id=#{id} ORDER BY id DESC
SELECT id,body,recipient_count,sent_at FROM encouragement_message WHERE id=#{id} AND mentor_id=#{mentorId}

SELECT u.id,u.nick_name AS name,u.user_name AS username FROM encouragement_recipient r JOIN sys_user u ON u.id=r.student_id JOIN encouragement_message m ON m.id=r.message_id WHERE m.id=#{id} AND m.mentor_id=#{mentorId} ORDER BY u.nick_name,u.id

SELECT m.id,m.body,m.sent_at,u.nick_name AS mentor_name FROM encouragement_recipient r JOIN encouragement_message m ON m.id=r.message_id JOIN sys_user u ON u.id=m.mentor_id WHERE r.student_id=#{id} ORDER BY m.id DESC
